spec.title: Watch_Skill_DSH_Final_Vision_2026-08-26.md
spec.note: Read in full from the copy supplied for this task. Not vendored into the repository and not modified; the digest is recorded so a future audit can confirm it read the same document.

rule: PASS requires tested evidence. A row naming no test cannot be PASS.

requirements.requirement: No release if the parity manifest contains an unknown capability.
requirements.evidence: 40/40 client product capabilities classified; verify-parity.mjs fails on any unclassified row and reads the generated inventory rather than a hand-kept list.

requirements.requirement: No release if a Client or Plugin can mint VERIFIED.
requirements.evidence: Proven twice over: no SDK export returns a verdict or evidence record, and every submission is rebuilt from an allowlist so a forged verdict is stripped and the attempt reported. The whole hostile corpus is submitted with verdict:VERIFIED and stripped every time.

requirements.requirement: No release if offline tests record non-loopback egress.
requirements.evidence: A process-level sentinel installed by --require patches net.Socket.connect, net.connect, tls.connect and every dns resolver beneath every outbound path. Twelve route families run under offline_only with zero non-loopback egress. A self-test arm attempts a real connection to example.com and must be caught, so a silent sentinel cannot pass for an absent one.
limitations: Covers the Node side. Watch Core has its own socket-level proof in watch-skill tests/test_offline_egress.py.
Upstream DSH Host code paths that no Watch surface reaches are not driven.

requirements.requirement: No release if a side effect can be repeated without idempotency or inspection.
requirements.evidence: The browser operator mints the idempotency key rather than the model; a consequential remote job whose lease expires becomes needs_resolution carrying its key rather than being requeued; an OCR worker timeout reports retryable:false.

requirements.requirement: No release on a contract or replay mismatch.
requirements.evidence: Schema digests are compared at handshake and drift disables only the affected family; projections and comparisons hash identically across runs.

requirements.requirement: No release with open critical Electron/IPC/plugin security findings.
requirements.evidence: Asserted as Electron actually applied it in a real launch: window.require, window.process and window.module all absent, preload exposing exactly nine operations. Wiring gated separately by a source check that also forbids kill-by-name.
limitations: The CSP header is not overridden for the Host origin, because the DSH web app bootstraps through an inline script in its own HTML. Loopback-only, supervised child; every other boundary unchanged.

requirements.requirement: No release if migration and rollback are untested.
requirements.evidence: Two genuinely different bundle versions packed and installed in sequence against stock DSH: upstream rows intact, no duplicate composition, session id and evidence ids stable, memory readable, settings preserved. Rollback B→A supported with state intact. Desktop update verifies signature, digest, downgrade and migration preflight in that order.

requirements.requirement: No release with missing SBOM, licences or notices.
requirements.evidence: SBOM over the Node tree with a licence allowlist gate; a real SPDX 2.3 document with a digest per first-party package; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES carrying the upstream MIT text and exact commit.
limitations: Covers the Node tree; the Python side has its own dependency set this SBOM does not enumerate.

requirements.requirement: No release if real-model claims are not separated from mocks and replay.
requirements.evidence: Capability truth distinguishes implemented / probed / machine_tested and only machine_tested counts as working. Every OCR matrix cell for both DeepSeek engines is NOT_TESTED, and a test asserts no code path can produce a metric without a run. Performance rows that could not be measured say not_measured with a reason.

requirements.requirement: No release if an engine loads remote code inside the DSH Host or Watch Core main process, or without a revision pin and isolation.
requirements.evidence: Isolation is the shape of the module: there is no in-process path and no flag producing one. The worker announces the revision it loaded and a mismatch is refused. Desktop capability detection deliberately does not probe heavy engines.

requirements.requirement: No release if an OCR engine is default without workload-specific qualification and a valid CPU fallback.
requirements.evidence: Routing prefers a qualified engine and an unmeasured one never becomes a default. With no GPU both DeepSeek engines are excluded and the lightweight CPU route is chosen.

requirements.requirement: No release if injected memory lacks provenance, scope, status or reason, or on a single cross-workspace leak.
requirements.evidence: Every context item carries an inclusion reason recorded in the ledger; every card exposes id, kind, scope, origin, confidence, status, provenance and last-confirmed. Cross-workspace and cross-user isolation are adversarially tested.

requirements.requirement: No release if a forgotten record still appears after projection and index rebuild.
requirements.evidence: Forget tombstones in the ledger and every projection is a fold over it, so the record is absent from retrieval, taste.md, replay and export — proven across a real restart.

requirements.requirement: No release if the Agent can change system policy, permissions or production skills without a promotion gate.
requirements.evidence: Forbidden targets are refused at proposal time; the proposer cannot approve its own candidate; a safety regression blocks promotion whatever else improved, and a swap that nets to zero is counted as a regression.

requirements.requirement: Official DSH capabilities classified and preserved; bundle installs on the pinned baseline; models, providers, sessions, tools, plugins and settings work; Trajectory complete; upstream notices correct.
requirements.evidence: The Web app is the real DSH web app with the Watch bundle as a layer. Install and uninstall run against a real stock profile with upstream rows intact, and the profile now actually boots and serves.

requirements.requirement: Evidence, verdict, freshness and provenance from Core only; claim → evidence → timestamp round trip; Agent complete ≠ Verified in data and UI; snapshot/delta/reconnect/replay reliable.
requirements.evidence: Journey 1 walks claim to evidence to exact timestamp to deep link to replay. Journey 3 has the receipt say dispatched and the verdict say FAILED, with the headline taking the failure.

requirements.requirement: Every injected memory carries id, origin, scope, status and inclusion reason; taste.md rebuildable and unable to mint evidence; correction beats inference next turn; Forget blocks retrieval, export and index; no cross-scope leakage or sensitive-trait inference; Agent may propose but not self-promote.
requirements.evidence: The thirteen-step slice runs end to end across a restart. A protected-subject claim is refused at every origin except an authenticated person — a gap found by aiming the hostile corpus at every door rather than at the one it was written for.

requirements.requirement: DeepWatch Web works local and single-user hosted.
requirements.evidence: Local Web runs: the real DSH Web Host serving the Watch bundle on loopback, with Watch Core spawned as a child over stdio and the Watch client bundle served to the browser.
limitations: Single-user hosted is the same distribution behind an authenticated origin. It is NOT MACHINE TESTED here: no hosted deployment was stood up, and the Web security boundary tests cover the policy rather than a running hosted instance.

requirements.requirement: Watch Desktop uses the same Workspace packages.
requirements.evidence: Electron 33.4.11 loads the same DSH web app from a Host this process supervises, which spawns the same Watch Core. There is no second UI.
limitations: Launched and machine-tested on win32 only.

requirements.requirement: Watch for DSH installable, offering the same capability contracts.
requirements.evidence: Five installable shapes, install/upgrade/uninstall against stock DSH, and the same tool surface in every one.

requirements.requirement: One provider experience for all external connections, one Technology Center for local engines, unified Role Bindings for every capability.
requirements.evidence: Role bindings sit over DSH Models and Providers with no second credential store; the Technology Center owns local engine descriptors and lifecycle.
limitations: The DSH Settings surface that edits bindings is inherited from upstream; Watch adds no editor of its own, and none was exercised in a browser here.

requirements.requirement: DeepSeek-OCR an optional worker with a revision pin, licence/provenance, resource receipt, and a usable CPU fallback.
requirements.evidence: Descriptors pinned, weights non-distributable, worker isolated and lifecycle-tested, CPU route selected when no GPU is present.
limitations: No GPU here, so neither DeepSeek engine is machine-tested and no quality number exists.

requirements.requirement: Agent, Watch, Live, Memory, Library, Compare, Trajectory; right inspector; bottom timeline; deep links.
requirements.evidence: Seven modes over one session, nine inspector panels, eight timeline lanes with three densities, and deep links that survive losing all client state.

requirements.requirement: Arabic RTL, keyboard, high contrast; degraded, gap, stale and unverified states clear; Why remembered? and Confirm/Edit/Reject/Forget reachable.
requirements.evidence: Roles, accessible names, one selected tab per strip, a disabled mode carrying its reason, every verdict with a glyph and a word, focus-visible with an offset, a forced-colours ring, no hand-written RTL block and no physical offsets.
limitations: Screen-reader announcement is NOT MACHINE TESTED: no assistive technology was driven.

requirements.requirement: Permissions, secrets, offline, approval digests; no blind side-effect retry; Electron boundaries and loopback protection; safe mode, read-only replay, diagnostics; signed Desktop artifacts and SBOM.
requirements.evidence: All but signing are covered by the rows above. Signing is development-key only.
limitations: PRODUCTION SIGNING NOT PROVEN — no production credential exists.

requirements.requirement: Parity, contract, replay, visual, E2E, perf and security gates green; real-model and hardware claims honest; install/update/rollback support matrix published.
requirements.evidence: 938 workspace tests, lint, strict TypeScript build and seven generated-artifact gates green; install, upgrade, rollback and boot smokes green; performance measured with the machine recorded.

requirements.requirement: Every official DSH journey has preserved/extended/replaced-with-reason and a test.
requirements.evidence: 40/40 classified, gate reads the generated inventory.

requirements.requirement: Stock DSH installs the Watch bundle with no manual patch.
requirements.evidence: Install smoke against a real stock 0.1.1-rc.2 profile; uninstall leaves upstream untouched.

requirements.requirement: Watch Core passes its regression gates and legacy surfaces are not broken.
requirements.evidence: Full Python suite green against the repository-equivalent configuration.
limitations: Run in the watch-skill repository; the count and exit code are recorded in the audit.

requirements.requirement: One full journey crosses Agent → Tool → Observation → Evidence → Verification → Receipt → Replay.
requirements.evidence: Journey 1, end to end, with the deep link reopening the same record and the projection hashing identically.

requirements.requirement: DSH Trajectory shows the four planes and opens stable deep links.
requirements.evidence: Watch records are contributed through DSH event definitions with a unified selection model; a link restores the same logical selection.
limitations: Watch publishes its own view target rather than adding rows to upstream’s ledger; upstream’s contribution union is closed.

requirements.requirement: Provider, engine and role truth does not rest on declarations; probes are documented.
requirements.evidence: Presence on disk is not readiness; only machine_tested counts as working, and a mode backed by a merely implemented capability renders degraded.

requirements.requirement: An offline test proves zero external egress, and media cloud upload needs separate consent.
requirements.evidence: Socket-level, twelve route families, with the positive control. Holding a provider key does not permit media to leave, and an agent can flip neither flag.

requirements.requirement: Plugin, Client and LLM cannot mint VERIFIED.
requirements.evidence: By shape and at runtime, with the attempt reported rather than silently stripped.

requirements.requirement: Cancellation, reconnect, replay and idempotency work across the Node↔Python boundary.
requirements.evidence: Deadlines, cancel-after-dispatch, split frames and engine loss are driven against a real framed-stdio fixture; the live client recovers a cursor break without splicing.

requirements.requirement: The Web UI loses no official DSH capability and builds no duplicate session, settings or plugin systems.
requirements.evidence: The Web app is upstream’s, served by upstream’s host. Watch contributes rows, tools, a client bundle and slots — it ships no session store, no settings system and no plugin runtime.

requirements.requirement: One fixture per agreed script tier passes evidence round trip; weak results appear as limitations.
requirements.evidence: Six scripts round-trip byte for byte through index, search, citation and render; a translation is a view and never what a citation resolves to.

requirements.requirement: Install, update, rollback and diagnostics documented and re-testable.
requirements.evidence: Four runnable smokes plus a release manifest carrying the compatibility and migration blocks.

requirements.requirement: Memory Off, Session-only and Local Personal work, and every injected item has provenance, scope and reason.
requirements.evidence: The four modes are proven to behave differently, not merely to be labelled differently.

requirements.requirement: Correction beats inference next turn, and Forget removes a record from retrieval, projections, indexes and export.
requirements.evidence: Proven in the slice, and forgetting a correction is proven not to resurrect the value it superseded.

requirements.requirement: Imported Markdown never becomes an instruction or explicit-user truth, and no self-promotion without eval and approval.
requirements.evidence: Four refusals on import; imported origin at fixed low confidence whatever a bundle claims; promotion needs an independent approval and a clean evaluation.

requirements.requirement: The browser does not talk to Python directly; loopback services have origin and bootstrap-token protection.
requirements.evidence: The browser reaches only the DSH Web Host on loopback; Watch Core is a stdio child of the Host and holds no socket. The Host binds 127.0.0.1 and carries upstream’s /api browser-trust fence.

requirements.requirement: Hosted profiles: HttpOnly session, CSRF on commands, auth and origin checks on WebSocket/SSE, short-lived scoped artifact URLs, upload sniffing and limits, private media off public CDNs.
requirements.evidence: These are upstream Host responsibilities in a hosted deployment, and no hosted instance was stood up on this machine. Watch adds no endpoint of its own and no second session system.
limitations: Local Web is the profile that was run and proven. Single-user hosted is NOT MACHINE TESTED here.

requirements.requirement: Artifact URLs are scoped to workspace, user and range.
requirements.evidence: Tenant-scoped authorization refuses an artifact in another tenant and the denial is byte-identical to one for an id that does not exist.
limitations: Enforced by the tenancy model. Binding it to upstream’s artifact routes in a hosted deployment is not exercised here.

requirements.requirement: nodeIntegration false, contextIsolation true, renderer sandbox, strict CSP, IPC sender validation, navigation and new-window allowlists, native permissions denied by default, no secrets on a command line, signed full-package updates, kill by instance-scoped identity only.
requirements.evidence: Every item is enforced and tested; the launch confirms Electron agreed. Kill-by-name is forbidden by a source gate across every desktop file.
limitations: Strict CSP applies to the shipped local renderer. It is not imposed on the Host origin, which bootstraps through an inline script; that origin is loopback-only and served by a supervised child.

requirements.requirement: Single-instance lock, app-data and migration preflight, one-time bootstrap secret, Host on 127.0.0.1 with a random port, Core handshake, readiness before the trusted origin opens, graceful shutdown.
requirements.evidence: The sequence runs in order with each step named in the readiness state; the Host binds an OS-chosen port; a newer store puts the app into read-only replay rather than being opened.

requirements.requirement: The original text is the evidence; normalized and translated forms are derived and a citation never resolves to one.
requirements.evidence: Six scripts, byte equality end to end; folding is stored beside the original and never cited.

requirements.requirement: OCR routing is script-aware and an unqualified engine is not a default.
requirements.evidence: Qualification is per engine × workload × script and an unmeasured cell never wins a default.

requirements.requirement: A configured API key does not mean media upload consent.
requirements.evidence: Two independent flags, and an agent may flip neither.

requirements.requirement: A repository code licence is not enough to distribute model weights.
requirements.evidence: OCR2’s repository is Apache-2.0 and distribution is still refused.

requirements.requirement: taste.md is a readable, editable projection — not a system prompt and not canonical mutable text.
requirements.evidence: Rebuilt from the ledger; a hand edit is a proposal that the rebuild then reflects.

requirements.requirement: A full public marketplace.
requirements.evidence: Explicitly placed outside Foundation by §39.6.

requirements.evidence: Explicitly placed outside Foundation by §39.6.

requirements.evidence: Explicitly placed outside Foundation by §39.6.
